in_marathi.name: Bipin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bipin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bipin originates from Sanskrit and is derived from the words 'bipi' meaning 'conscious' and 'n' meaning 'in'. Thus, Bipin can be interpreted as 'the one who is conscious'. This name is often given to children who are believed to possess a deep understanding of the world and the ability to think and act wisely.
